capability: Parsing of external Folding@Home stats during a manual update: points and units are read from the stub and diffed against the user's initial stats, the hardware multiplier is applied to points only (with half-up rounding), a stub that answers 500 leaves all stats untouched while still returning 200, and a stub that answers unparseable JSON makes the update fail with 500 and leaves the system in a write-blocked state until it is restarted.
